messages:
Nina (Marketing): Draft blog post is in GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LaunchX. Need quick reviews on benchmark framing + webinar CTA/lead routing. Goal: publish Mon.
Omar (Product): Adding a 2-line "Who should care" comparing Dedicated vs Private. Keep it simple.
Felix (Eng): Benchmarks look good but need hardware + seq length. I'll add: p99 @ 512 tokens on A100-80GB (high perf) and A10G (cost-optimized). Also note quantization caveat.
Dana (Sales): Lead routing: hidden fields we need: team_owner=(sdr|ae), lead_tier=(self-serve|enterprise), source=blog. Also please set utm_campaign=launch_q3_webinar. Who owns HubSpot form?
Pri (Content): Reworking intro to be problem-first. Proposed headline options in doc; vote there. Will tighten CTA language.
Legal: Check: remove any "guarantee" phrasing. Add privacy line under CTA: "We use your email to contact you about product access; we do not sell personal data."
Nina (Marketing): Pasting HubSpot embed (minimal):
```html
<form action="https://api.hubapi.com/contacts/v1/contact/?hapikey=demo" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="blog" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="launch_q3_webinar" />
  <input type="hidden" name="team_owner" value="enterprise" />
  <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Work email" required />
  <button type="submit">Save my seat & early access</button>
</form>
```
Omar (Product): +1. Add a one-liner about canary rollouts so enterprises see ops controls.
Dana (Sales): Please ensure Ops tags contacts with "campaign: blog_launch" so we can filter. Also request a test contact flow before publish (sales+test@redwood.com).
Felix (Eng): I'll drop the hardware footnote and update the benchmarks by EOD.
Nina (Marketing): Final checklist: Felix updates numbers; Legal privacy blurb done; Dana confirms mapping; Pri final headline. Will merge edits and ping for final sign-off tomorrow at 10am.
Pri (Content): Done with headline options; please vote.
Legal: Approved the final copy with the privacy line added.
Nina (Marketing): Thanks all  aiming to publish Mon 9am PT. Any last blockers?
Dana (Sales): No blockers; Ops test pending.
Felix (Eng): No blockers on my side.
Nina (Marketing): Great  marking as in-review and will follow up tomorrow. :rocket
